The dark-haired woman catches it and eagerly pulls the boat towards the jetty with both hands. The water reflects the trees.

desc: In a log cabin with a burning wood stove and snow outside the window, a bearded man in a navy jumper, cream trousers and dark socks stands on a wooden chair, gripping a straw broom and staring down in fright. On the wooden floor below, a small white mouse moves around beside a knocked-over mug. At the end the man lifts the broom up high with both hands and holds it upright in front of him. A sheepskin rug and a metal bucket of firewood are in the room.

desc: In a small apartment kitchen, a blue passenger train rushes past right outside the tall window, blurred with speed and filling the whole window. A young woman in a green top and black leggings stands barefoot by the counter holding a phone and a mug, turns, and stares at the train with her mouth open. At a small table a bearded young man in a blue T-shirt calmly keeps eating cereal from a bowl, and a tabby cat sleeps on the windowsill beside a potted herb. A pink morning sky shows above the train.

desc: A jockey in a green silk shirt with white stars and a white helmet rides a grey horse along the white rail of the parade ring at a crowded racecourse on a grey day, led by a man in a dark jacket. Jockeys in bright silks on brown horses follow behind. As the grey horse walks closer, a huge crowd pressed against the rail, many in green and white scarves and rosettes, holds up phones and cameras towards it. A packed grandstand and bare trees stand behind.
